nyheter.instruktion: Highlight news that concerns me — about {amnen} — weighed against who I am and what I work on. News is something that has happened: a decision, a launch, a statement, a report, a deal, a person who changed roles. Set aside product pages, guides, home pages and ads. Also set aside anything that isn't about the topics, even if the source is serious — a university page about medicine is not news about {forsta}. Better few and important than many.
